# New-ZbxDiscoveryRule

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a discovery rule.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxDiscoveryRule [[-Name] <string>] [[-Type] <ZabbixItemType>] [-HostId <ulong>] [-Uuid <string>] [-Key <string>] [-LifetimeType <ZabbixLldLifetimeType>] [-Lifetime <string>] [-EnabledLifetimeType <ZabbixLldEnabledLifetimeType>] [-EnabledLifetime <string>] [-Description <string>] [-Status <ZabbixItemStatus>] [-Preprocessing <ZabbixPreprocessingStepRequest[]>] [-LldMacroPath <ZabbixDiscoveryRuleLldMacroPathRequest[]>] [-Filter <ZabbixDiscoveryRuleFilterRequest>] [-Override <ZabbixDiscoveryRuleOverrideRequest[]>] [-Parameter <ZabbixDiscoveryRuleParameterRequest[]>] [-Params <string>] [-Timeout <string>] [-Delay <string>] [-Username <string>] [-Password <SecureString>] [-MasterItemId <ulong>] [-InterfaceId <ulong>] [-Url <string>] [-QueryField <ZabbixDiscoveryRuleQueryFieldRequest[]>] [-RequestMethod <ZabbixHttpRequestMethod>] [-PostType <ZabbixItemPostType>] [-Posts <string>] [-Header <ZabbixDiscoveryRuleHeaderRequest[]>] [-StatusCodes <string>] [-FollowRedirects <bool>] [-RetrieveMode <ZabbixHttpTestRetrieveMode>] [-OutputFormat <ZabbixItemHttpOutputFormat>] [-HttpProxy <string>] [-AuthType <int>] [-VerifyPeer <bool>] [-VerifyHost <bool>] [-SslCertFile <string>] [-SslKeyFile <string>] [-SslKeyPassword <SecureString>] [-AllowTraps <bool>] [-TrapperHosts <string>] [-IpmiSensor <string>] [-JmxEndpoint <string>] [-SnmpOid <string>] [-PublicKey <string>] [-PrivateKey <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A low-level discovery rule finds the parts of a host that come and go, such as file systems, network interfaces or databases, and creates items, triggers and graphs for each from prototypes. The New-ZbxDiscoveryRule cmdlet sends discoveryrule.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new discovery rule back with discoveryrule.get and writes it. The server requires -Name, -Type and -Key; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. A host or template piped from Get-ZbxHost or Get-ZbxTemplate binds -HostId, so one command creates a discovery rule on each. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a low-level discovery rule that receives its data

```powershell
$web = Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01'
New-ZbxDiscoveryRule -HostId $web.HostId -Name 'App endpoints' -Key 'app.endpoints.discovery' -Type Trapper |
    Select-Object ItemId, Name, Key, Type, Lifetime
```

A trapper LLD rule (-Type Trapper) takes discovery JSON sent to its key (Send-ZbxData); -HostId takes the host's id. The created rule is read back and written; Lifetime is how long lost entities are kept (7d by default).

### Example 2: Create an agent discovery rule with its own schedule

```powershell
$web = Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01'
New-ZbxDiscoveryRule -HostId $web.HostId -Name 'Mounted filesystems' -Key 'vfs.fs.discovery' -Type ZabbixActive -Delay '1h' `
    -LifetimeType After -Lifetime '3d' | Select-Object Name, Key, Type, Delay, Lifetime
```

An active agent rule (-Type ZabbixActive) runs on the agent every -Delay; -LifetimeType/-Lifetime say when resources the rule no longer finds are deleted.

### Example 3: Create the rule on a template

```powershell
$template = Get-ZbxTemplate -Name 'Web App'
$null = New-ZbxDiscoveryRule -HostId $template.TemplateId -Name 'App endpoints' -Key 'app.endpoints.discovery' -Type Trapper
Get-ZbxDiscoveryRule -Template 'Web App' | Select-Object ItemId, Name, Key, HostId
```

On a template the rule is inherited by every host that links it; -HostId takes the template's id.

- `ZabbixItemPostType`: Bound to -PostType (ByPropertyName). The item post type values: ZBX_POSTTYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixDiscoveryRuleHeaderRequest[]`: Bound to -Header (ByPropertyName). headers of a ZabbixDiscoveryRuleCreateRequest.
- `bool`: Bound to -FollowRedirects (ByPropertyName), -VerifyPeer (ByPropertyName), -VerifyHost (ByPropertyName), -AllowTraps (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixHttpTestRetrieveMode`: Bound to -RetrieveMode (ByPropertyName). The HTTP test retrieve mode values: HTTPTEST_STEP_RETRIEVE_MODE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixItemHttpOutputFormat`: Bound to -OutputFormat (ByPropertyName). The item HTTP output format values: HTTPCHECK_STORE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `int`: Bound to -AuthType (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixDiscoveryRule`: The discovery rule read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.
